hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, APOE4 undergoes increased aggregation in the endo-lysosome compared with APOE3.

paper.title: Lysosomal proteomics reveals mechanisms of neuronal APOE4-associated lysosomal dysfunction.

findings.finding_description: LysoIP proteomics compared lysosomes from Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE4 versus APOE3 and versus HsAPOE−/− parental cells. APOE itself was significantly accumulated in HsAPOE4 lysosomes relative to both controls. This measures lysosomal abundance of APOE, not aggregation, so it is a surrogate for B. The cells are a mouse neuroblastoma line, not human brain cells.
findings.quote: Through this approach, we found that HsAPOE4-expressing lysosomes accumulated APOE itself, AD-associated secretase proteins (PSEN2, CD63, TSPAN3)
findings.summary: APOE protein accumulates in lysosomes of APOE4-expressing Neuro-2a cells compared with APOE3 and APOE-null cells; aggregation was not assessed.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 genomic locus (TMEM192-3xHA LysoIP proteomics)

findings.finding_description: Ratiometric OregonGreen-dextran measurement showed that HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells had alkalinized lysosomes (pH 5.86) compared with HsAPOE3 cells (pH 4.30) and HsAPOE−/− cells (pH 4.58). This lysosomal environment could favor protein aggregation, but APOE aggregation itself was not measured, so the link to the hypothesis is only a distal surrogate.
findings.quote: We found that HsAPOE4-expressing cells exhibit dramatic lysosomal alkalinization (pH = 5.86) compared to HsAPOE3 (pH = 4.30) cells (Figure 1C–E)
findings.summary: APOE4 Neuro-2a lysosomes are markedly alkalinized compared with APOE3 lysosomes, a condition potentially permissive for aggregation.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 genomic locus

findings.finding_description: Magic Red Cathepsin B assay showed significantly decreased lysosomal proteolysis in HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells compared with HsAPOE3 cells. Impaired degradation could contribute to aggregate retention, but APOE aggregation was not measured.
findings.quote: We found that the HsAPOE4-expressing cells exhibited significantly decreased MR-CTSB proteolysis compared to HsAPOE3-expressing cells, in line with their decreased lysosomal acidity (Figure 1F,G).
findings.summary: APOE4 Neuro-2a cells show reduced lysosomal cathepsin B proteolysis, an indirect surrogate for impaired clearance of aggregates.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 genomic locus

findings.finding_description: Lysosomal immunoprecipitation proteomics in Neuro-2a cells stably expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 found that HsAPOE4 was preferentially localized in lysosomes relative to HsAPOE3. This is classed as directness 3 because the genotype is varied directly but lysosomal abundance or localization stands in for aggregation, which was not measured. The system is mouse neuroblastoma cells, not human brain cells. In this excerpt the finding is stated only in the Discussion; the underlying data are presented elsewhere in the paper.
findings.quote: In line with previous studies [56,102], we found HsAPOE4 to preferentially localize in lysosomes relative to its HsAPOE3 counterpart.
findings.summary: APOE4 is enriched in lysosomes relative to APOE3 in neuronal cells, but aggregation itself was not assessed.
findings.experimental_system: Mouse Neuro-2a neuroblastoma cells stably expressing transgenic human APOE3 or APOE4 (endogenous murine Apoe intact); LysoIP proteomics
findings.data_location: Discussion (supporting data not in this excerpt)
